source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of blockchain in financial services (PDF 166-167).

blocks.text: Bank aur maali idare transactions tez aur mehfooz banane ke liye blockchain istemal karte hain; bairon-e-mulk paisa bhejna, jo aksar sust aur mehnga hai, tez aur sasta ho sakta hai. Kuch fankar digital art bechne ke liye blockchain istemal karte hain, jahan munfarid digital signature saabit karta hai ke har fan para asal hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: BISE certificates ki dasti tasdeeq ka blockchain tasdeeq se muwazna kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Dasti: board ko darkhwast bhejna, staff ke records jaanchne ka intezar, der, ghalti aur jaali certificates ke khatre ke saath. Blockchain: board har certificate ki tafseel ek baar na-qabil-e-tabdeel ledger par darj karta hai, aur koi bhi us record se foran jaanch sakta hai, jo tez, jaali banana mushkil aur kai darkhwaston tak qabil-e-tausee hai. Students blockchain simulation tool se yeh aazma sakte hain.

items: Maaliyat: tez, sasti, mehfooz muntaqili; certificates jaise qabil-e-tasdeeq records.
